theme_and_archetype.description: A sophisticated, editorial-grade celestial aesthetic ('Vogue-meets-Cosmos'). We are avoiding all cliché deep-blue/purple neon cosmic gradients. The design relies heavily on warm neutrals, deep contrasts, generous whitespace, and elegant serif typography to convey ancient wisdom with modern luxury.

background.description: Bone White / Cloud Dancer. The primary background for all marketing pages and dashboard main areas.

surface.description: Soft Warm Beige. Used for cards, sidebars, and interactive surfaces. Glass variant is for sticky headers with backdrop-blur-xl.

text.description: Obsidian / Soft Charcoal. Pure black is avoided. These deep hues provide high contrast for legibility while maintaining a soft, printed-ink feel.

brand.description: Espresso Brown (Primary CTA, major text), Antique Brass (subtle borders, icons, highlights), Sage Green (success states, subtle tags).

headings.styling: tracking-tight for large headings (H1, H2) to create an editorial, high-fashion look. Never use Inter or Space Grotesk.

body.styling: Clean, geometric contrast to the ornate serif. Used for paragraphs, data tables, and forms.

accents.labels: uppercase, tracking-[0.2em], text-xs, font-medium (e.g., for 'ASTROLOGY REPORT' overlines or form labels).

spacing_and_layout.global_spacing: Generous Spacing Philosophy. Sections should have py-24 or py-32 to feel breathable and luxurious.

grids.marketing: Asymmetrical editorial grids. Use col-span variations to break up monotony. Images should slightly overlap text containers.
grids.reports: Bento-style or strict 3-column masonry grid. Substantial padding inside cards (p-8).
grids.admin: Control Room Grid. Tight spacing (gap-6) but utilizing the soft beige background to reduce eye strain.

spacing_and_layout.borders: Avoid heavy drop shadows. Use 1px solid borders using Antique Brass (#B89764) at 20% opacity or Espresso Brown at 10% opacity.

buttons.primary: bg-[#3A302A] text-[#F9F8F3] hover:bg-[#1F1D1A] rounded-none px-8 py-4 transition-colors duration-300
buttons.secondary: bg-transparent border border-[#3A302A]/20 text-[#3A302A] hover:bg-[#F0EFED] rounded-none px-8 py-4 transition-colors duration-300
buttons.accent: bg-[#B89764] text-white hover:bg-[#A38555] rounded-none px-8 py-4

cards.reports: bg-[#F0EFED] border border-[#B89764]/20 p-8 rounded-sm hover:shadow-[0_8px_32px_rgba(58,48,42,0.05)] transition-all group

forms.inputs: bg-transparent border-b border-[#3A302A]/20 rounded-none px-0 py-3 focus:outline-none focus:border-[#3A302A] focus:ring-0 text-[#1F1D1A] placeholder-[#4C4643]/50
forms.labels: text-xs uppercase tracking-widest text-[#4C4643] mb-2 block

navigation.header: sticky top-0 z-50 bg-[#F9F8F3]/80 backdrop-blur-xl border-b border-[#3A302A]/10
navigation.admin_sidebar: w-64 bg-[#F0EFED] border-r border-[#3A302A]/10 min-h-screen p-6

animations.entrance: Fade up with Framer Motion (y: 20, opacity: 0 -> y: 0, opacity: 1, duration: 0.8, ease: [0.16, 1, 0.3, 1]). Soft, elegant, unhurried.
animations.hover: Images inside report cards should have a very slow, slight scale up (scale-105 duration-700) on group hover.
animations.parallax: Use subtle scroll parallax on large cosmic background textures.

hero_backgrounds.description: Soft beige wavy abstract texture, perfect for full-screen hero backgrounds with overlaid typography.
Organic dunes/texture in beige, suitable for section dividers or footer background.

reports_and_celestial.description: Nine phases of Venus shown in a grid. Use as thumbnail for major reports (e.g., Complete Horoscope).
Vintage surveying instrument. Good for Career or Finance prediction report thumbnails.

testimonials_and_portraits.description: Elegant portrait on neutral background, to be used in the reviews/testimonials section.

data_testid_instructions.details: All interactive elements, buttons, form inputs, report cards, and navigation links MUST have a data-testid attribute. Use kebab-case and role-based naming (e.g., data-testid='generate-report-button', data-testid='dob-input').

instructions_to_main_agent.1: Inject Cormorant Garamond and Manrope fonts into the project via Google Fonts in index.html or global css.
instructions_to_main_agent.2: Avoid using default Shadcn card wrappers if they enforce heavy shadows or rounded borders. Use raw HTML/Tailwind divs with the specified component styles.
instructions_to_main_agent.3: For the multi-step birth details form, do not use basic bounded inputs. Use the bottom-border only style defined in component_styling.forms.inputs for an editorial feel.
instructions_to_main_agent.4: The Payment flow (Razorpay) is mocked. Build a beautiful UI for the checkout step with loading animations and success states before directing to the user dashboard.
instructions_to_main_agent.5: Admin dashboard needs Shadcn charts (Recharts) configured with the primary (#3A302A) and accent (#B89764) colors instead of default Vercel blues.
instructions_to_main_agent.6: Always verify APCA contrast on text overlaid on images. Use a gradient overlay (bg-gradient-to-b from-[#F9F8F3]/10 to-[#F9F8F3]/90) if needed to protect text readability on light backgrounds.
instructions_to_main_agent.7: Do not create `.tsx` files; generate standard `.js` files using React + Tailwind.
